messages:
maria: heads-up — started seeing tail latency spikes for hosted inference (eastus2) ~00:30 UTC, p99 jumped from ~120ms to ~480ms.

tony: saw that alert too. retransmits and dup acks up on inter-host flows. kernel tcp_retransmits looks elevated.

kim: running a quick check — looks like qos-agent v2.3 rolled out a policing policy that added an ingress tbf on eth0 of gpu nodes.

infra-bot: policy-rollout: qos-agent v2.3 deployed to 87/120 hosts in eastus2 at 2025-03-01T00:29:48Z

lucas: paste tc output I grabbed from one gpu host:
```
# tc -s qdisc show dev eth0
qdisc ingress ffff: dev eth0 parent 1:fff1 ----------------
 qdisc tbf 1: root rate 10gbit burst 1Mb limit 10Mb
 Sent 1234567 bytes  packets 9876 drop 432 overlimits 12
 backlog 0b 0p requeues 0
qdisc fq_codel 0: dev eth0 root refcnt 2 limit 10240p
 Sent 987654321 bytes  packets 54321
```

kim: interesting — ingress tbf seems to be limiting bursts and interacting badly with RDMA/queue pairing. we're seeing packet reordering + small MTU path fragments.

ton y: i ran `tcpdump -i eth0 -nn -c 100 'tcp'` and saw lots of retransmits + duplicate ACKs. also `ibv_rc_pingpong` shows higher latencies on those hosts.

maria: confirmed via Grafana: inference p99 00:20–00:40 UTC: 120->490ms, after disable it dropped back to 130ms. Canary rollback in flight.

sre-oncall: disabling ingress policing on canary 10 hosts now. policy -> disabled. monitoring.

infra-bot: policy-change: qos-agent v2.3 rollback applied to canary subset (10 hosts) at 2025-03-01T00:35:12Z

lucas: canary looks good. p99 back to ~125ms over last 5m. no retransmits on those hosts.

kim: root cause is qos-agent's heuristic misclassifying RDMA port ranges as bulk egress and applying token-bucket. filing INFRA-2021 and PR to qos-agent to skip gpu nodes / RDMA ports.

maria: creating follow-up: patch + safer rollout (gradual + metric gating). assigning to @kim and @tony. :thumbsup:

tony: i'll patch the policy to add `match not proto rdma` and add a preflight iperf test.

sre-oncall: leaving the rollback live while we get the patch merged. will coordinate with scheduling to re-roll with canary steps.

maria: thanks all — reopening if anything else pops up.
